title: Space bar (almost) stops working in Pidgin with Quick Accent enabled

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: Quick Accent reportedly suppresses ordinary spaces in Pidgin; the reporter confirmed the problem still occurred in 2024.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve ordinary space input when Quick Accent does not activate
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a normal space is treated as an accent trigger or fails to be replayed after an incomplete gesture; verify event timing before changing the hook.
plan: Reproduce normal typing in Pidgin with Quick Accent enabled and disabled and compare a current build.
Trace key-down/up decisions around space and the accent activation threshold.
Correct the demonstrated suppression or replay defect and add tests for normal typing and intentional accent selection.
verification: Normal spaces reach Pidgin and intentional space-triggered accent selection still works.

reproduce.title: Preserve ordinary space input when Quick Accent does not activate
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported build and current PowerToys build
prerequisites: Windows, Pidgin and Quick Accent enabled
A test account and a non-sensitive text input
setup: Select Space as the Quick Accent activation key and focus a Pidgin chat field.
steps: Type several ordinary words with spaces at normal speed.
Repeat with Quick Accent disabled and compare.
Enable it again and deliberately trigger an accent to check the intended gesture.
reproduce.expected_result: Ordinary spaces appear reliably while deliberate accent selection remains available.
